details: Word-by-word breakdown into English: Lafzon (Words) | Ke (Of) | Haseen (Beautiful) | Dhaagon (Threads) | Mein (In) | Kahin (Somewhere)
Literal translation: "Somewhere in the beautiful threads of words"
Translation: "Somewhere within the beautiful threads of my words"
Word-by-word breakdown into English: Piro (Weaving/Stringing) | Raha Hoon (Am [doing]) | Kabse (Since long) | Main (I) | Huzoor (O beautiful / My lord)
Literal translation: "I am weaving for so long, O beautiful one"
Translation: "I've been trying to weave you into words for so long, my beautiful one"
Word-by-word breakdown into English: Koshishein (Attempts/Efforts) | Zara (Slight) | Hai (Are) | Nigaahon (Eyes/Glances) | Ki (Of)
Literal translation: "There are slight efforts of the eyes"
Translation: "My eyes are trying their best"
Word-by-word breakdown into English: Tujhe (You) | Dekhne (Seeing) | Ki (Of) | Ho (May happen) | Khata (Mistake/Fault) | Zaroor (Definitely)
Literal translation: "May the mistake of looking at you definitely happen"
Translation: "To commit the beautiful mistake of looking at you"

lines.line: **Deewangi Kahun Isse Ya Hai Mera Fitoor**
details: Word-by-word breakdown into English: Deewangi (Madness/Craziness) | Kahun (Should I call) | Isse (This) | Ya (Or) | Hai (Is) | Mera (My) | Fitoor (Obsession)
Literal translation: "Should I call this craziness or is it my obsession?"
Translation: "Should I call this craziness, or is it my undying passion?"
Word-by-word breakdown into English: Koi (Some/An) | Hoor (Angel/Nymph) | Jaise (Like) | Tu (You)
Literal translation: "Some angel, like you"
Translation: "You are like an angel from above"

lines.line: **Bheege Mausam Ki Bheegi Subah Ka Hai Noor…**
details: Word-by-word breakdown into English: Bheege (Drenched) | Mausam (Season) | Ki (Of) | Bheegi (Drenched) | Subah (Morning) | Ka (Of) | Hai (Is) | Noor (Radiance/Light)
Literal translation: "Is the light of the drenched morning of the drenched season"
Translation: "You are the radiant glow of a rain-drenched morning in monsoon season"
Word-by-word breakdown into English: Kaise (How) | Door (Far/Away) | Tujhse (From you) | Main (I) | Rahoon (Stay/Remain)
Literal translation: "How away from you I stay?"
Translation: "How could I ever stay away from you?"
Word-by-word breakdown into English: Khamoshiyan (Silences) | Jo (If) | Sun Le (Listens to) | Meri (My)
Literal translation: "If [you] listen to my silences"
Translation: "If you were to listen to my silence"
Word-by-word breakdown into English: Inmein (In these) | Tera (Your) | Hi (Only) | Zikr (Mention) | Hai (Is)
Literal translation: "In these, only your mention is"
Translation: "You would find that it speaks only of you"
Word-by-word breakdown into English: Khwaabon (Dreams) | Mein (In) | Jo (If) | Tu (You) | Dekhe (Look into) | Mere (My)
Literal translation: "If you look into my dreams"
Translation: "If you were to look into my dreams"
Word-by-word breakdown into English: Tujhse (With you) | Hi (Only) | Hota (Happens) | Ishq (Love) | Hai (Is)
Literal translation: "Love happens with you only"
Translation: "You would see that I am in love with only you"

lines.line: **Ulfat Kaho Isse Meri, Na Kaho Hai Mera Kasoor**
details: Word-by-word breakdown into English: Ulfat (Love/Devotion) | Kaho (Call) | Isse (This) | Meri (My) | Na (Not) | Kaho (Say/Call) | Hai (Is) | Mera (My) | Kasoor (Fault/Blame)
Literal translation: "Call this my love, do not say it is my fault"
Translation: "Call this my deep devotion, but please don't hold it against me as a fault"
Word-by-word breakdown into English: Koi (Some/An) | Hoor (Angel/Nymph) | Jaise (Like) | Tu (You)
Literal translation: "Some angel, like you"
Translation: "You are like an angel from above"
